content.title: AMC Stock Snaps 11-Day Losing Streak as Box Office Concerns Loom
content.summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings  on Wednesday snapped an 11-day losing streak, the company’s worst since 2022. AMC is no stranger to challenges: Shares dropped in 2020 as movie theaters were forced to shut down operations because of the Covid-19 pandemic.
